app.notes: New timing modes: Rolling (30-70, 40-100, 60-130 or custom) and Braking 60-0, set in Settings > Performance. Drag runs add 0-30 and peak g. Trim any run to choose what shows when reviewing or sharing (incl. End at 1/8). Results screen time is now adjustable.
